opening.argument: The presentation is cautious enough to be read as an opportunity for viewers to inspect an app process, not as a guaranteed financial promise. Its description uses promotional language, but the available wording does not itself establish that every viewer will be paid or that participation is risk-free: it says only, "Play Game Earn Unlimited Paytm Cash Play game earn money daliy earning money." The title likewise identifies an app and a claimed rate, rather than proving an outcome: "1 Second ₹30 Rupee Add Paytm Wallet !! New Earning App 2020 Beast App." A careful viewer can treat these as claims requiring independent checking. The recording shows screens and procedures, while the supplied evidence does not establish a guaranteed return, a mandatory deposit, or a completed payment to the audience.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opposing account treats promotional wording as proof of deception. But "Unlimited" and a title mentioning ₹30 describe what the material claims; they do not establish that the creator guaranteed payment to every viewer. Likewise, mentioning an OTP in an app workflow does not show that viewers were actually induced to surrender one, and the available record does not establish a completed transfer or loss.
